author: spidey simp
description: Search configured Fandom and MediaWiki sites directly from Discord. Server managers can add or remove wiki mappings, while users can search for pages with autocomplete and exact or best-match results.
install_msg: Thank you for installing Fandom Search! Use `[p]load fandomsearch`, then use `/fandom upload_link` to configure a wiki and `/fandom search` to begin searching.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no end user data.
